claim.summary: For proper binary Boolean degree-D pseudoideal J, nonzero binary S<=Q_s, actual fixed binary errors E_i of degree<=e>=1, L=s+e and 2L<=D, T:S->Q_L^r, f->([E_i f]), admits one normalized old annihilator mu over a finite extension, nonsingular on Q_L,S,kerT. The shared input/output moment pairing gives Tdagger y=Pi_S(sum E_i y_i), with Pi determined by mu(f Pi v)=mu(fv), all tested products through2L. Thus Tdagger returns degree<=s and rank(T Tdagger)=rankT. A field larger than1+dimQ_L+dimS+dimkerT suffices. For S=[wU], w degree b and U binary linear through k, reserve2(b+k+e)<=D recovers each nonzero adjoint output as wq, q in extended U of degree<=k. Spaces/map are fixed before mu; no contraction, inverse-source theorem, uniformity for mu-dependent maps, or legal coefficient-map claim.
